description: Provenance registry. EVERY claim in the atlas must reference a source entry. Trust tiers rank source types - higher tier wins on conflict. Tiers are ordered: 1 highest to 5 lowest.

trust_tiers.label: Lab test (COA)
trust_tiers.definition: Certificates of analysis from licensed/accredited labs - cannabinoid and terpene quantification, contamination screens.
trust_tiers.example_use: Overriding claimed THC ranges with measured potency.

trust_tiers.label: Cup result
trust_tiers.definition: Published results from recognized competitions (High Times Cannabis Cup, Emerald Cup, etc.).

trust_tiers.label: Breeder claim
trust_tiers.definition: Statements from the original breeder / seed producer (catalog copy, lineage notes, lab tests commissioned by breeder).
trust_tiers.example_use: Lineage and flowering-time claims - always flag as breeder-asserted.

trust_tiers.label: Community report
trust_tiers.definition: Grower reports, forum archives, seedbank reviews, phenotype write-ups. Aggregated signal, individual noise.

trust_tiers.label: Academic
trust_tiers.definition: Peer-reviewed chemistry/phytochemistry literature and compound databases (PubChem etc.). Strong for compounds, weak for consumer claims.

sources.name: Steep Hill (COA publisher)
sources.scope: Cannabinoid/terpene lab testing; example template for lab_test citations.

sources.name: Confident Cannabis lab network
sources.scope: Lab network publishing COAs; example template for lab_test citations.

sources.name: Serious Seeds - AK-47
sources.scope: Breeder page for AK-47 lineage and cup claims.

sources.name: GrowDiaries
sources.scope: Public grow journals with strain tags.

sources.name: PubChem (NIH)
sources.scope: Compound records - formulas, published physical constants.
